# md4c (vendored)

CommonMark and GitHub-flavoured Markdown parser, used by `c/rolltui_markdown.c`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/mity/md4c
- Pinned commit: `61f5ce76647a93d60f652da8212e263ae2b4d8b7` (master, 2026-08-30)
- Files: `md4c.h`, `md4c.c` (from `src/`), `LICENSE.md` (MIT)
- Local modifications: none.

To update: copy the two files from a newer commit, update the commit above, and run
`rolltui-markdown-test`.
